load_coco_json: load a COCO JSON annotations file and return dataset records with images and annotations combined
register_dataset: register a single COCO DensePose dataset with DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog using CocoDatasetInfo
register_datasets: register multiple COCO DensePose datasets from an iterable of CocoDatasetInfo objects
get_metadata: get DensePose metadata dictionary containing UV symmetry transforms and SMPL subdivision file paths
maybe_filter_categories_cocoapi: filter and remap COCO API categories and annotations to contiguous IDs from MetadataCatalog
